text:
A Lake Wind Advisory is in effect, so if you're heading onto the water, take the wind seriously. Burlington starts crisp and clear, then warms quickly to a high near 77 with plenty of sun. South winds build through the day, reaching 15 to 25 knots on the broad lake with waves up to 3 feet. It'll be a beautiful day on shore, but less forgiving offshore, especially for smaller boats.

The change arrives after midnight, with showers likely and stronger south winds, then a damp, unsettled Sunday. Showers should be around before 10, with more showers and a chance of thunderstorms in the afternoon, and a high near 79. The forecast models are split on how wet Sunday gets, so I'd keep the rain gear close and stay alert for thunder. Drier, cooler weather follows Monday, with patchy frost possible Monday night. Enjoy the waterfront today, but be off the broad lake before the wind really ramps up.

week.blurb: Sunny and mild near 77, then rain likely after midnight, so finish outdoor plans before dark.
A damp, breezy Sunday near 79, with showers likely early and more storms possible later.
A cool, mostly sunny Monday near 68, though a stray early shower could linger.
Mostly sunny and comfortable near 71 Tuesday, with showers possible after dark.
A partly sunny Wednesday near 77, with only a small chance of an early shower.
Clouds and scattered showers take over Thursday, with a mild high near 77.
Mostly sunny Friday near 72, though a few showers remain possible.
